actual_patch_operation.new_text: The control matrix has bounded interpretations. The physical-versus-unit comparison changes temporal variation and can diagnose whether a result depends on a nonconstant roof, but cannot establish geometric fidelity. The lawful shuffled control preserves the declared one-point roof-value multiset while breaking predeclared symbolic placement; failure may diagnose placement sensitivity, not arithmetic structure. The neighboring-geometry roof changes only the predeclared separation parameter and can diagnose local geometry sensitivity, but cannot alter the primary \texttt{d=6a} object or support an extrapolation theorem. Every control uses the registered statistic \(\Delta_c\), pre-output exact rational threshold \(\eta_c\), Gate-4 joint enclosure \([L_c,U_c]\), and the three states \path{SEPARATED}, \path{NOT_SEPARATED}, and \path{INDETERMINATE}. The symbolic contract is fixed, but \(\Omega\), each threshold value, and every numerical enclosure remain \texttt{UNASSIGNED}, so the current gate is \path{CONTROL_NOT_EVALUABLE}. No comparison has been executed, and nonarithmetic methods value creates no Route-A relevance.

The six typed gates make a later classical-dynamics computation auditable, while their nonarithmetic methods value creates no Route-A arithmetic relevance.

actual_patch_operation.new_text:
The frozen controls have distinct interpretations.  The unit roof preserves
coding and owner policy while removing pointwise temporal variation; it can
diagnose dependence on a nonconstant roof but not geometric fidelity.  The
order-three cyclic label map is a symmetry/invariance control: it preserves
equilateral geometry, adjacency, and roof information up to relabeling, so it
tests label equivariance rather than placement sensitivity.  The neighboring
\(d=61/10\) roof changes the exact geometry while preserving the registered
symbolic interface only if no-eclipse is separately certified; it can test local
geometry sensitivity but cannot alter or extrapolate from the primary \(d=6\)
system.  All use the fixed \(\Omega\), \(\eta_c=1/100\), joint enclosure, and
three-way decision rule stated above.  No comparison or enclosure has been
executed, and the controls create no Route-A or Route-B credit.
